title: Resident CUDA/Metal adapter sessions prefill with base weights via batched Prefiller
reason: Batched-prefill seam (residentPrefillSeed) never checked for a bound LoRA adapter, so adapter sessions took the default batched path that ignores the delta.
path_missed: residentPrefillSeed Prefiller branch / backends' PrefillLast decline

title: Resident prefix reuse ignores which adapter built the cached KV
reason: Reuse rule matched token ids only; the adapter that produced the KV was unrecorded state, so cross-adapter prefixes were reused as if identical.
option_or_family: adapter binding that built resident KV (resIDs)

title: Bailing Hybrid KDA state missing from Recurrent bit and hasRecurrentState
reason: A new recurrent state kind is absent from the registry bit, predicate and reset arm; reuse, reset and spec rollback treat it as non-recurrent default.

title: Cohere resident CUDA uses RMSNorm tail; batched prefill ignores layerNorm/parallelBlock
reason: Tails call r.rms unconditionally and prefillStaticDecline lacks layerNorm/parallelBlock, so the LayerNorm family runs the RMSNorm default; paths never knew the feature, so not N.
path_missed: CUDA decode/prefill tail norm dispatch and prefillStaticDecline

title: Dense Granite GGUF q/k rows not un-permuted; missing from ggufQKPermuted
reason: The two-name permutation list omitted granite, so its llama.cpp-permuted q/k loaded in the default HF order; fix adds the name.

title: WebGPU gpt-oss int4 down-projection dispatches int8 kernel over W4A8 stack
reason: The gpt-oss down builder had no s.w4 branch, so int4 stacks took the default W8A8 kernel; fix branches on w4.

title: Metal executor commits buffer pre-encoded under previous adapter after SetAdapter
reason: SetAdapter's lifecycle path did not account for the executor's pre-encoded command-buffer state, so stale state ran. R over O (stale-state hazard).

title: Metal batched prefill on paged generic MoE binds zero-value expert buffers
reason: prefillOK checks features and geometry but not the expert-paging load option, so paged MoE runs batched prefill as if unpaged.

title: WebGPU int8-KV m-RoPE decode writes K scale at rope position
reason: The i8 shader handles both int8 KV and m-RoPE but indexes the scale write by ropePos, not pos: wrong buffer offset. R arguable, N fits better.

title: Parity manifest aikit_version stale again; staleness gate disarmed
reason: A hand-typed manifest field let the deps_hash freshness gate stay green across two aikit bumps; the gate does not check what it claims.

title: olmo_hybrid validated with deps_hash covering zero source files
reason: Freshness gate accepted a validated family with empty dependency sets, so no source edit could ever restale it.

title: Seven v0.17.0 families' parity gates cannot block any release
reason: CI skips gitignored fixtures, the sweep files FAIL as FIRST-RUN and the ledger is unpromoted, so no gate can stop a tag. Reopens G-04 (09-02).

title: deps_hash refreshed by hand bypassing refusal; -update lacks refusal
reason: The refresh refusal lives outside the test binary and was bypassed; -update refreshes hashes without green goldens. Gate/release check defect.

title: Recurrent-bit census and spec-rollback tests use hand-written family lists
reason: Test oracles are hand-written family lists, so a family absent from both passes as non-recurrent (hid C-03).

title: Resident-LoRA gates never drive PrefillLast or an armed Metal executor
reason: Gates call per-token Forward on fresh executors, a calling convention production does not use, so they cannot see C-01 or C-07.

title: gpt-oss WebGPU parity fixture bias-dominated; 0.95 floor hides dropped term
reason: Fixture and floor cannot detect a dropped expert down matmul (C-06); a test that does not check what it claims.

title: Metal prefill gate silently narrows decision set; fit decline still SHIPS
reason: Gate drops cells lacking reference files and Skipfs a failed decision model yet reports SHIPS. Sibling, not re-file, of G-01 (09-02).

title: PTX freshness has no device-free check; absence counts as skip
reason: No CI check ties embedded PTX to .cu sources, and the only check's absence is a counted skip on a PASS.

title: webgpu-parity cell selects only ResidentParity; seven WebGPU gates never run
reason: The gate cell's test filter misses gate-shaped WebGPU tests, so they run nowhere; entry calls it a partial regression of G-09 (09-02).

title: FMA lint misses reversed multiply-add; one ships in prefill_batched.cu
reason: Filed as a lint that cannot see c + a*b. The shipped bare MAC (batched vs sequential Q scale) is N-like, but the entry's defect is the gate.

title: serve check tools and stop rows pass without checking outcomes
reason: Doctor rows certify tool turn-two and stop sequences without reading content or finish state; checks do not check what they claim.

title: Smaller gate instances: hand-listed modules, vacuous checks, misleading skips
reason: All eleven are test/CI/release-check defects; dominant (b) hand-lists 15/22 PTX modules, (c) hand-counts GGUF families; others vacuous greps, skips, a pinned false banner.

title: Adapter and reused-image VL resident prompts past cap die with 500
reason: Cap applied only when residentPath is true; the no-adapter predicate and VL's hard-coded false miss routes now resident. R over B: cap exists, routes unregistered.
option_or_family: adapter-bound and reused-image VL resident routes
path_missed: prepare's residentPath predicate (lm.adapter == "") and P9a reuse branch

title: VL resident clamp sites omit BudgetClamped; truncated turns report stop
reason: Seven VL paths clamp but never publish the clamp state, so effectiveBudget treats them as the unclamped default. R vs O (reporting bug) near-equal.
option_or_family: resident-cap budget clamp (Budget/BudgetClamped) on VL paths

title: n-gram and draft-model spec loops error at resident context cap
reason: Draft width plus position can exceed the resident context cap with no clamp in either loop; fix is a bound clamp. Repeats M-13 (09-02) in sibling loops.
path_missed: spec_ngram / speculative draft-width computation before ForwardN

title: .giw bundles keep config.json EOS only, losing generation_config stop ids
reason: Serializer and .giw loader branch never carried the merged generation_config EOS set, defaulting to config.json's; registration fix writes the resolved list. R vs O.
option_or_family: generation_config.json extra EOS ids (resolved EOS set)

title: Compute-time LoRA never validates delta In/Out against base projection
reason: Adapter delta dims can exceed the base projection's array sizes with nothing checking, causing panic or OOB; B over O since the panic follows an unchecked size.

title: GenerateVL imgHash zero documented as never matching, but matches
reason: Block-match guard treated the zero no-claim sentinel as an ordinary hash; fix adds a named non-match. R tested before G (doc vs code).

title: GenerateGemma4VL commits resIDs without an image-block record
reason: Gemma 4 VL's commit omits the image-block state its two siblings record, so prefix reuse treats image positions as plain text.

title: Model.Plan reports resident by features alone, not ResidentEligible
reason: Plan's admission predicate omits families and backends the runtime declines, defaulting them to resident; fix registers the ResidentEligible check.
option_or_family: Llama-4/cuda, dense Gemma 4/webgpu, Kimi-K2/metal, unrecognised backends

title: Staged WebGPU int4 decode, prefill and verify use different kernels
reason: Spec-decode exactness guard did not know staged-webgpu int4 splits M=1 and M>1 kernels; fix is a named refusal. False comment (G) secondary.

title: CUDA resident HiddenLast breaks bit-identity above 512 tokens, ungated
reason: Fast-lever selection ignored that the HiddenLast tail requires exact kernels, treating it as ordinary prefill; fix registers forceExactKernels. N/G aspects secondary.

title: CUDA spec-verify exact only because M stays below 16
reason: Lever predicates did not know verify passes need exact kernels; row floors held by coincidence. R over B: fix registers pass kind, not a bound.

title: Fit-by-default interior ctx never passes checkKVFits, falls to CPU
reason: Plan sizes ctx with zero headroom while checkKVFits demands a 384 MiB margin; the sizing arithmetic disagrees. Not B: a check exists.

title: Non-streaming JSON writes have no deadline while decode mutex held
reason: A stalled client blocks the write and pins worker slots: hang/resource exhaustion, not registration, bound or numerics.

title: --fit=off printed by server is rejected by the flag parser
reason: Server message and task doc state a flag value the bool parser rejects (rubric's README-flag case); chat lacking --fit is secondary O.

title: Pre-tokenize guard ignores tool schemas and tool-call arguments
reason: A byte budget exists but tool fields bypass it, so oversized inputs reach full BPE unchecked. B vs R (unregistered request fields) close.

title: /v1/responses silently drops tools on templates lacking tool support
reason: Path treats tools on a tool-less template as the tools-less default; fix is the named 400 its siblings have. R vs O (request validation).
option_or_family: tools on a template with no tool form

title: Serve loads decoder-embedder with empty Options, ignoring backend and quant
reason: Embedder loader drops the --backend (and quant) option, so it takes the default CPU path; fix passes the option through.

title: CUDA vision tower leaks scratch per image and is never enabled
reason: Dominant defect is a per-image device scratch/stream leak (O); cuda missing from serve's enable check is R-shaped and the DONE doc claim is G.

title: fit reads free RAM after loading the model it plans
reason: Fit derives the CPU budget from a probe taken after the model consumed RAM, mis-sizing ctx and slots. N vs O (ordering bug) close.

title: fit -measure double-loads checkpoint and folds prefill into rate
reason: Keeping the first model resident during a second load is a resource/lifecycle defect; the prefill-in-rate half is N-like arithmetic. O vs N close.
